articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, Aug. 13, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AXIL Brands, Inc. (“AXIL,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: AXIL), an emerging global consumer products company for AXIL® hearing protection and enhancement products and Reviv3® hair and skin care products, today announced a significant new wholesale partnership with a prominent U.S. membership-based retail chain.
articles.title: AXIL Brands, Inc. Announces Major National Retail Partnership
